footer.sentBy: This email was sent by Ronne at {host}.
footer.notice: Ronne sends one whenever the way you sign in to your account changes. These emails can't be turned off.
footer.contact: To reach your administrator, reply to this email or write to {contact}.
footer.contactReply: To reach your administrator, reply to this email.

test.subject: Test email from Ronne at {host}
test.body: Root sent this test email from Admin › Settings › Email. It reached you, so Ronne can send email.
test.notYou: If you didn't expect it, you can ignore it: nothing about your account changed.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your account on {host} was changed.
password_changed.notYou: If this wasn't you, someone else may know your password. Contact your administrator at once.

password_reset.subject: A root set a new password for you
password_reset.body: A root set a new password for your account on {host}. Your old password no longer works.
password_reset.notYou: If you didn't ask for this, contact your administrator at once.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor sign-in was turned on
two_factor_enabled.body: Two-factor sign-in was turned on for your account on {host}. Signing in now also asks for a code from an authenticator app.
two_factor_enabled.notYou: If this wasn't you, someone else may be signed in to your account. Contact your administrator at once.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor sign-in was turned off
two_factor_disabled.body: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for your account on {host}. Signing in now asks for your password only.
two_factor_disabled.notYou: If this wasn't you, someone else may be signed in to your account. Contact your administrator at once.

backup_codes_regenerated.subject: New backup codes were made
backup_codes_regenerated.body: New backup codes were made for your account on {host}. The old ones no longer work.
backup_codes_regenerated.notYou: If this wasn't you, someone else may be signed in to your account. Contact your administrator at once.

two_factor_reset.subject: A root turned off your two-factor sign-in
two_factor_reset.body: A root turned off two-factor sign-in for your account on {host}. Signing in now asks for your password only, until you turn it on again.
two_factor_reset.notYou: If you didn't ask for this, contact your administrator at once.

sso_linked.subject: A company sign-in was linked to your account
sso_linked.body: Your account on {host} can now be signed in to with {provider}.
sso_linked.notYou: If this wasn't you, contact your administrator at once.

sign_up_code.subject: Your code for {host}: {code}
sign_up_code.body: Your code to create an account on {host} is {code}. It works for {minutes} minutes. Type it in the window where you signed up.
sign_up_code.notYou: If this wasn't you, ignore this email: no account is created without the code.

sign_up_existing.subject: You already have an account on {host}
sign_up_existing.body: Someone tried to create an account on {host} with this address, but you already have one. Sign in, or ask your administrator to reset your password.
sign_up_existing.notYou: If this wasn't you, ignore this email: nothing about your account changed.

sign_up_approved.subject: Your account on {host} is approved
sign_up_approved.body: {how, select, provider {A root approved the account made on {host} when you signed in with {provider}. You can sign in now, with {provider}.} other {A root approved the account you created on {host}. You can sign in now, with the email and password you chose.}}
sign_up_approved.notYou: If you didn't create an account there, contact your administrator.

sign_up_declined.subject: Your account on {host} wasn't approved
sign_up_declined.body: {how, select, provider {The account made on {host} when you signed in with {provider} wasn't approved, so it was deleted. You can ask your administrator why.} other {The account you created on {host} wasn't approved, so it was deleted, with what you typed. You can ask your administrator why.}}
sign_up_declined.notYou: If you didn't create an account there, ignore this email: nothing is left of it.
